title: Five Minutes
briefing: His phone is unlocked on the counter. The shower is still running. You told yourself you wouldn't.

questions.rationale: Sable's late night messages and unsent notes show an intimate affair, not a professional relationship.
questions.evidenceHint: Review Sable's thread and the unsent draft in Notes.

questions.prompt: Did Eli lie about Thursday night?
questions.rationale: Eli claimed he was working late with Theo, but location records show he went to Sable's apartment.
questions.evidenceHint: Compare Theo's text message with the location log in Maps.

questions.rationale: Location pins and incoming calls place Eli directly at Sable's apartment.
questions.evidenceHint: Check the timestamped location pins on Maps.

questions.prompt: Was Theo used as a cover story?
questions.rationale: Eli asked Theo to corroborate his whereabouts if questioned.
questions.evidenceHint: Read the opening messages in Theo's text thread.

questions.prompt: Did Theo know the cover was a lie?
questions.rationale: Theo agreed to cover for Eli, but thread messages never explicitly reveal if he knew about Sable.
Messages and social posts refer to 'the usual' as Sable's private apartment.
questions.evidenceHint: Check the caption on the Thursday photo social post.

questions.rationale: Sable explicitly mentions Rae in text messages asking when Eli will tell her.

questions.prompt: Has Eli been careful about his phone around Sable?
questions.rationale: Eli reminds Sable to send ephemeral snaps rather than standard SMS.

questions.prompt: Is Ivy's bakery thread about a surprise for Rae?
questions.rationale: Ivy's bakery order is an innocent event order, unrelated to Rae's surprise.

questions.prompt: Does Ivy know about Sable and Eli?
questions.rationale: No evidence in Ivy's texts suggests she was aware of Eli's affair.
questions.evidenceHint: Ivy's messages focus solely on catering.

questions.prompt: How long has this been going on?
questions.rationale: The unsent note specifies 'it's been weeks'.
questions.evidenceHint: Look at the unsent note draft in Notes.

questions.prompt: Who was the unsent note for?
questions.rationale: The draft note addresses Sable directly about ending the secret meetings.
questions.evidenceHint: Read the full text of the unsent note.

questions.rationale: Recent calls and location logs prove active ongoing meetings.

questions.prompt: Is the mom thread related to Sable?
questions.rationale: The conversation with Mom is entirely routine family chatter.

questions.prompt: Is Eli planning to leave Rae?
questions.rationale: Eli expresses hesitation and conflict in drafts, but never commits to leaving.
questions.evidenceHint: Compare the draft note with Sable's DMs.
